inputs.name: homeassistant_version
inputs.description: Tag of the Home Assistant image, such as "2026.11.0". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for homeassistant_version, such as "sha256:c6c1...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: image_repository
inputs.description: Where to pull Home Assistant's image from. "docker.io/homeassistant/home-assistant" serves the same image from Docker Hub.

inputs.name: listen_addresses
inputs.description: Addresses Home Assistant's web server listens on, set at its first start. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; add the host's LAN address, or use ["0.0.0.0"], for phones and browsers to reach it directly.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: Port Home Assistant's web server listens on, set at its first start.

inputs.name: trusted_proxies
inputs.description: Reverse proxies allowed to set X-Forwarded-For, as addresses or networks, such as ["127.0.0.1"] for a proxy on the same host. Home Assistant refuses forwarded requests from any proxy not listed. Set at its first start.

inputs.name: devices
inputs.description: Host devices to pass into the container, such as ["/dev/ttyACM0"] for a Zigbee or Z-Wave stick. Prefer the stable names under /dev/serial/by-id.
